svg.title: Common-scale radial ocular-slice skin/scales source comparison
Radial source reference, negative-X YZ view
svg.desc: Contacts over body and ocular slice over material are explicit diagnostic compositing conventions. Only front scale fragments are shown; no physical exterior-eye or finished-art claim.
